entries.title: Diagram no longer pushes the More button along
entries.body: With the Experimental features switch on, the Diagram button used to push the More button (the three dots) one place along the bar of modes, and on a phone off the edge, so it jumped to the front. Diagram now comes after More, which follows Skim whether the switch is on or off.

entries.title: Sketch labels use the AI's typeface
entries.body: The words inside a Sketch picture are drawn in the typeface the app uses for other words the AI wrote. Sketches made before this change show the new typeface too, and because it is wider, some of their labels may be cut shorter than before.
